scope: New qualification on the same A100 for the existing ordered native 32-request serving entry. The HTTP experiment stopped on its A/A: the unchanged warm reference changed one text in 32. That terminal outcome and its two full controls are preserved. No HTTP release permission.
workload: Original restart_arm.py, GgmlEngine and real CPU Pilot. Same Qwen3-32B, native/driver/W4 library and dispatch table, PS1, ps1a, PK6. Each new worker selects PK2 locally with no externally fixed threshold. Submit a complete ordered mixed 32-client batch of length 32, a second same-size warm batch and 18 factual answers. Factual-first pairs additionally deliver two complete sets of 18 questions before the mixed waves. Compare exact ordered output IDs, text, stop, geometry, native masks, estimated costs and numerical threshold. No serving profile tuning from test results.
scoring: Two reference A/A starts. All six matched cold mixed wins; median >=1.02 and improvement larger than A/A spread. Both factual-first pairs win and median >=1.02. Median relative warm wall and p95 first-token latency <=1.02 in each family, each peak RSS and measured GPU allocation <=1.05. At least one actual accelerated local decision. Entire broker launch to final token counts. Corresponding reference/candidate answer IDs, stops, texts, geometry and thresholds must match. Reject on mandatory failure, including A/A or quality mismatch. No change to these rules after observing a pair. Individual K1/K2 HTTP wave timings never enter these labels.
order: Mixed seeds alternate reference-first, candidate-first starting reference-first. Factual-first seeds alternate in reverse. The independent head learns only from the mixed family and reserves both factual-first seeds as a family holdout. A fixed always-use-qualified candidate rule is a comparator. One generated source, zero new author calls.
target: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB with precommitted device SHA 112d8a87ea0f7aab9de32ad3b2f2d65318c3bce1044ee30b75f78c528c923e2b. Additional native work must fit the existing watchdog and aggregate 20 USD cap. Raw records copied incrementally to the control machine.
